# Regional archives

661 institutions, authorities and service points; 384 browsing units. Checked 2026-11-02.

**Coverage is partial.** A listing does not establish surviving records or open scans. Resolve event-date jurisdiction and record creator before choosing a keeper. Authorities and service offices are not automatically holding repositories.

## Use

Search locality variants, date and record type with `scripts/search_catalogue.py`. Check fonds and inventories before names. Users handle login, payment and requests; agents stop restricted routes.

[Historical locality lookup](historical/finding-a-volost.md) · [Empire](historical/russian-empire.md) · [USSR](historical/soviet-union.md) · [External custodians](external-custodians/README.md) · [Coverage](COVERAGE.md).

Data: archives.json stores institution facts; jurisdictions.json stores browsing units and historical routes; coverage.json stores unresolved work. Shared defaults and verification references are expanded by scripts/common.py. Generated country guides are the only Markdown copy of institution descriptions.
